name: ai-dev
description: UNQUALIFIED AI development candidate: RV64, one core, native TFR tensor arithmetic and STD scalar FPU. Configuration checks are not GPU execution or physical performance evidence.

sources.baseline: Source design basis: da55a516a48b49013724f697d3c12a48932b449f. See docs/project/configurations.md; this profile has no measured reference block.
sources.xlen: Select the RV64 leg permitted by ci/testcases/tensor_wg.yaml defaults; this choice is a candidate for qualification, not an accepted ODR-001 decision.
sources.VX_CFG_NUM_WARPS, VX_CFG_NUM_THREADS, VX: 8 warps, 8 threads and issue width 2 from tensor_wg:sgemm_tcu_wg-2, an inherited SimX-only FP16 case.
sources.VX_CFG_NUM_ALU_BLOCKS, VX_CFG_NUM_LSU_BL: One block per listed unit as explicitly pinned by tensor_wg:sgemm_tcu_wg-2. Tensor blocks remain derived as 2 because VX_tcu_block.sv requires NUM_TCU_BLOCKS == ISSUE_WIDTH.
sources.VX_CFG_FPU_TYPE: STD is the native scalar-FPU option used by config2:dogfood-2. Pinning it here prevents an ambient SV_DPI setting from selecting scalar DPI; this combination still needs independent execution qualification.
sources.VX_CFG_EXT_TCU_ENABLE, VX_CFG_TCU_WGMMA_: Enabled explicitly by tensor_wg:sgemm_tcu_wg-2; the global VX_config.toml defaults remain disabled.
sources.VX_CFG_TCU_TYPE, VX_CFG_TCU_FP16_ENABLE: Pin the inherited VX_config.toml native TFR and FP16-enabled defaults; support and numerical semantics must still be proven in P01/P02.
sources.VX_CFG_NUM_CLUSTERS, VX_CFG_NUM_CORES: Pin the one-cluster, one-core VX_config.toml defaults to keep the candidate bounded. All unlisted configuration values remain revision-dependent defaults.
